comparison.objective: Start a handheld 3D scanner and scan a cast housing from all required viewpoints for CAD comparison.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a control button while moving and orienting the scanner around the part with adequate coverage.
comparison.success_condition: Scanner is started and the housing obtains the required all-around/top coverage and usable comparison data.
comparison.reason: Sensor trajectory planning and surface coverage are unrelated to contact-loaded fracture and physical recovery of released tangs.
